messages:
Isha: Opening a quick PR to fix examples in the quotas + billing analytics page. Noticed mixed uses of `billing_tier` vs `tier_label` in code blocks.
Ben: link?
Isha: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4897 - WIP. Changes: unify label to `billing_tier`, update SDK examples, add an hourly alert query, and a small CSV migration note.
Ari: can you paste the JS snippet here so i can sanity-check header casing?
Isha: `fetch('/v1/usage', {headers: {'Authorization': 'Bearer x', 'X-Rw-Billing-Tier': 'pro'}})` Also added a Node middleware fallback: `const tier = req.headers['x-rw-billing-tier'] || req.headers['x-old-tier'] || deriveTier(req.user)`
Ben: good. For Grafana we should change variable name to `$billing_tier` and update templated queries. I'll open a tiny dash PR to rename the var.
leo-bot: docs linter: no errors.
Isha: added a worked example for burst math: "Pro baseline 200r/m, burst 1000 tokens; sustained 260r/m -> 60r/m from burst -> 16.6m to deplete."
Ari: please make the math explicit: show the division and units.
Isha: updated. Also added an alert sample: `expr: sum(rate(token_consumption[5m])) by (billing_tier) > 1000` and an hourly rollup example using `increase(token_consumption[1h])`.
infra: note: usage-export column rename planned for 2026-05-10; ops will announce.
Ben: left two editorial comments in the PR about phrasing and the CSV example (suggest csvkit).
Isha: switched awk -> csvkit per feedback. pushed. PR is ready for final review.
Ari: approved.
Isha: merged and scheduled docs rebuild. Closing thread.
